red: The Rust contract tests initially failed to compile because the native facade did not expose contract version, transport identities, connection snapshots, bounds or request-aware undo.
The JavaScript contract tests initially failed because session-connection.mjs did not exist and native map/zone identities were not projected separately from editor rule IDs.

The retry regression failed after an admitted preparation failure because React reused consumed request identity 1. The adapter now refreshes the canonical connection and the next successful request uses identity 2.

contract.wire_identity: Instrument, attachment, revision and next-request values are canonical unsigned decimal strings and are never converted through JavaScript Number.
contract.ownership: Rust owns the constants, monotonic transport identities, disposable attachment lifetime and accepted snapshot. C++ carries the ABI fields without numeric narrowing; JavaScript validates the exact version, limits and u64 domain at entry.
contract.request_recovery: A terminal failure still consumes its monotonic request identity. React refreshes the accepted connection snapshot before a retry and validates the returned request, revision and next-request identity on success.

native_boundary.connection: Each InstrumentHostWebBridge opens one session attachment and disconnects it during deterministic destruction. Exact instance and attachment identities are required for mapping and undo admission.
native_boundary.worker: Mapping and undo run through the processor-owned asynchronous session worker and the existing off-audio activation gate; status records remain bounded at 128.
native_boundary.signed_oracle: The actual bridge maps kit/kick from MIDI 36 to 60, renders literal -0.5 at MIDI 60, invokes native undo, and restores literal -0.5 at MIDI 36.
native_boundary.integration_build: The final React production bundle was regenerated, embedded into the native resource target, release-linked into dandrum-trigger-native-bridge-test and passed its concrete bridge test.

react_boundary.identity: Native map and zone IDs survive projection independently of the editor-facing rule ID.
react_boundary.adoption: Only native-identified key-range updateRule operations use the session command. Other fields and all unmigrated operations continue through whole-document preparation.
react_boundary.history: Migrated operations bypass Store's closure journal and use numeric ordering tokens alongside local commands. Native undo refreshes the canonical document and history; preview MockEngine behavior remains local.
react_boundary.validation: The adapter rejects version drift, noncanonical, zero or overflowing identities, altered limits, invalid history counts, incoherent status identity/revision and exhausted request IDs.
